title: What teachermodel reads from a curriculum unit (a local, pinned mirror under standards/units/)
description: One file per unit version, standards/units/<slug>@<ver>.yaml, named for its id. the curriculum system owns the unit; this is the part clearance depends on. A dry run is bound to the hash of environment, failure_catalogue and run_sheet (units.environment_sha256), so a change to any of them voids earlier dry runs. Failure ids and run-sheet step ids must be unique within the unit (checked by units.document_errors, which JSON Schema cannot express).

authors.description: Optional, additive within major 1 (increment 3, W12). The SME authors of this unit version, as registered instructors. When a unit file gains a version, open-candidates opens a candidate (dry run and clearance, W3 and W4) for each author and delivery mode they hold no valid clearance for. Not part of the dry-run hash.

environment.description: The lab environment the unit runs in; part of the dry-run hash

failure_catalogue.description: Failures a dry run can inject; one is chosen and handled, and the fallback is exercised

run_sheet.description: Optional. The steps the facilitator walks, in order; part of the dry-run hash
